question_or_symptom: Canonical HTTPS identity and local source acquisition were conflated, causing official GitHub/Hugging Face operations to stall on this network.
observation: GitHub SSH through ssh.github.com:443 reliably resolved canonical GitHub repositories, while canonical Hugging Face API/Git remained blocked. Official Hugging Face fixed-revision pages were reachable through the browsing transport, and a mirror exposed metadata for the same full commit.
conclusion: Source identity, transport, and evidence provenance are separate fields and must never be inferred from one another.
decision: Keep canonical upstream URLs in .gitmodules and SOURCE_LOCK, record SSH fetch transports separately, fail closed on local official API failure, and label mirror metadata as cross-check-only.
invalidated_assumptions: A reachable mirror can stand in for an official revision lock.
One network transport will work uniformly for GitHub and Hugging Face.
